title: Runway launches AI model router as generative media gets crowded
slides: Runway offers a new path, but which model wins?
The router picks the best AI for each media task.
Most teams still choose one model for everything.
You now get top results without switching tools.
Test your current output against the router's pick.
thread_text:
1. One model fails daily.

Most teams still rely on a single AI for all tasks, but benchmarks show it misses the mark on half of media formats.

2. The router beats the single model.

A routing system picks different AI tools per task. Videos get one model, images another — and it consistently outperforms any single choice.

3. No more tool switching.

The router works inside your existing interface. You don’t learn new software — the decision happens invisibly behind your prompt.

4. Your output is already behind.

Teams that test their current AI against the router’s pick see a measurable quality gap. The difference is not theoretical.

5. Run your own test this week.

Take one prompt you use daily. Get output from your current model and from the router. Which one would you ship?
